title: Yomiuri: Hitachi Partners With Fanuc on Physical AI
source_used: The Japan News and MarketWatch (headlines only)
why_it_matters_hint: The Yomiuri Shimbun reports that Hitachi and Fanuc are partnering on physical AI; no terms are known.
event_date: Published 13 Oct 2026 (Japan News 06:29 UTC, MarketWatch 11:46 UTC).
notes: MarketWatch needs a subscription (HTTP 401) and The Japan News (the Yomiuri's English edition, which MarketWatch credits) answers with a bot challenge, so only headlines are known: The Japan News 'Hitachi, Robot Maker Fanuc Launch Physical AI Partnership' and MarketWatch 'Yomiuri: Hitachi Partners With Fanuc on Physical AI'. Nothing beyond that is claimed.
